title: A full root filesystem
scenario: A deployment failed because the root filesystem is nearly full. Find the largest obvious log file and inspect it.
hint: Start with `df -h`, then inspect `/var/log` with `find /var/log` and read the application log.

title: A busy application host
scenario: Users report slow responses. Check the simulated process list and identify the worker using the most CPU.
hint: Use `ps` to view process names and CPU percentages.

title: A denied configuration file
scenario: A service account cannot read its configuration. Inspect the file and the path permissions.
hint: Use `ls -l` on `/srv/app/config.yml` and inspect parent directories with `find /srv/app`.

title: A stopped web service
scenario: The web service is not responding. Review the simulated service status and recent log.
hint: Use `cat /var/log/nginx/error.log` to inspect the sample error, then `ps aux` to review simulated processes.

title: A client cannot connect
scenario: A client cannot reach the app. Inspect the simulated host address and resolver settings.
hint: Read `/etc/hosts` and `/etc/resolv.conf` to inspect the sample name and resolver configuration.
